notice.message: Mesquite 4.02 is available. This update has several bug fixes a few new features compared to 4.01. Version 4 is a major update over 3.x, with many new features for phylogenomics, data management, visualizations, and analyses. Tree inference programs (IQ-TREE, RAxML), aligners (MAFFT, MUSCLE) and trimming programs (trimAl, Gblocks) are built in. Includes the Zephyr, Chromaseq, and Cartographer packages. Learn more and download here.
